title: SvgMarker
responsibility: Renders the native marker element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgMarker.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered as child content inside the <marker> when supplied; when omitted, the element has no children from this component. The snippet is called without arguments, and the component does not otherwise interpret its markup.

outputs.name: SvgMarker
outputs.description: The native SVG <marker> element produced by this component, with every prop other than children forwarded as an attribute. When children is supplied, its snippet is rendered inside the element; the component adds no wrapper or marker-specific behavior.
